stories.title: Russian Helicopter Allegedly Breaches Finnish Airspace Amid Drone Attacks
stories.summary: Finland's Defense Ministry suspects a Russian helicopter violated its airspace, potentially linked to a drone strike on a Russian cargo ship earlier on the same day. The cargo ship, reportedly associated with Russia's armed forces, was attacked by two drones in the Gulf of Finland, prompting the evacuation of its crew.

stories.title: Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, Former Deputy President of South Africa, Passes Away at 71
stories.summary: Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, who served as South Africa's first deputy president and led UN Women from 2013 to 2021, has passed away at the age of 71. Her contributions to both national and international platforms were significant during her career.

stories.title: Russian Missiles Land in Poland Amid NATO Exercises
stories.summary: Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone landed in Poland, which Prime Minister Donald Tusk described as likely an intentional provocation. This incident coincided with European military exercises in Poland related to a potential postwar mission in Ukraine. NATO has labeled the missile landings a 'grave violation' of Polish airspace.
